45/G.goal: Explain how an empirical usability evaluation is planned during system implementation by structuring a study with testable research questions and measurable variables.
45/G.achieves: It lets the learner evaluate an implemented XR system's usability with objective, evidence-based methods before moving to optimization.

45/O1.goal: Explain why full empirical usability evaluation is required after code testing in system implementation.
45/O1.achieves: It lets the learner distinguish valid implementation-stage usability evidence from code testing and quick prototype evaluations.

45/O2.goal: Describe how to structure an empirical usability study, including its stages, testable research questions, and measurable variables.
45/O2.achieves: It lets the learner specify objective usability evidence for an implemented XR system, supporting the course's case-study implementation stage.
